scope: All 136 remaining whole-token gdje, neha, and kak variants in the four editable Latin components.
choice: Normalize gdje to official kde, neha to official nehaj, and standalone kak to official kako, preserving capitalization.
motivation: The reader had already selected kde, nehaj, and kako as its canonical all-corpus surfaces but earlier batches missed these spelling variants. Official kde is type 1 with positive evidence across every listed Slavic standard; official nehaj is the declared jussive; official phrase and conjunction entries use kako. Leaving the variants would preserve an unjustified Croatian/Russian-shaped mixture.
alternatives_rejected: Keep residual national variants as unexplained doublets.
Wait for human review of already-established reader policy.

validation.structure: TeX controls, references, braces, and math delimiters unchanged
validation.outputs: dry-run hashes frozen before write and reproduced after write
